BL-0.1.4-008-S1.title: Define Rate Limiting Policy Schema and Configuration Contract
BL-0.1.4-008-S1.description: Define configurable rate limiting policies including request thresholds, time windows, and keying strategy (IP, session, or API key). Establish a schema for storing and retrieving rate limit configs.
BL-0.1.4-008-S1.evidence: ASSUMPTION: No existing rate limiting configuration; GAP required for policy definition

BL-0.1.4-008-S2.title: Implement Core Rate Limiting Logic
BL-0.1.4-008-S2.description: Implement backend logic to track request counts per key (IP/session) and enforce limits using sliding window or fixed window strategy with in-memory or Mongo-backed counters.
BL-0.1.4-008-S2.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py (demonstrates request metadata capture patterns); ASSUMPTION: reuse similar tracking approach for rate counters

BL-0.1.4-008-S3.title: Integrate Rate Limiting Middleware into FastAPI
BL-0.1.4-008-S3.description: Add middleware to FastAPI entrypoint to intercept requests, apply rate limiting checks, and return 429 responses when limits are exceeded. Ensure compatibility with existing tool routing and chat endpoints.

BL-0.1.4-008-S4.title: Rate Limiting Unit and Integration Tests
BL-0.1.4-008-S4.description: Create tests to validate rate limiting behavior including threshold enforcement, reset windows, and correct HTTP 429 responses. Include integration tests against chat and tool endpoints.
BL-0.1.4-008-S4.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/test_tool_router.py (pattern for endpoint-level testing); ASSUMPTION: extend test suite for middleware validation

BL-0.1.4-008.mitigation: Start with simple IP-based limits and conservative thresholds
